websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Business websites or domains, one per line (e.g. joespizzanyc.com). You can also write "Business Name | domain.com". Use this or a Google Maps dataset below (or both).

mapsDatasetId.title: Google Maps dataset
mapsDatasetId.description: Pick (or paste the ID of) the dataset from a Google Maps scraper run, e.g. compass/crawler-google-places. Uses title, website, phone, rating, review count, category, city and emails. Read-only access to just this dataset.

businessNames.title: Business names (optional)
businessNames.description: Optional names matching the Websites list line by line. Used in the pitch and email opener.

maxBusinesses.title: Max businesses
maxBusinesses.description: Stop after auditing this many businesses (after de-duplication by domain).

includePitch.title: Generate pitch angle and email opener
includePitch.description: Add a pitchAngle and a one-line emailOpener for the biggest problem found. Template-based, no AI cost.

includeNoWebsite.title: Include Maps businesses without a website
includeNoWebsite.description: Output Google Maps rows that have no website (or only a Facebook page) as top-priority 'no website' leads. They count as an audit.

onlyNew.title: Only new businesses (skip ones audited before)
onlyNew.description: Remember audited domains between runs and skip them. Handy for scheduled runs on a growing lead list. Skipped businesses are not charged.

monitorKey.title: Memory key for 'only new'
monitorKey.description: Name of the memory used by 'only new'. Use different keys for different campaigns. Defaults to the Maps dataset ID or 'default'.

maxSubpages.title: Extra pages per site
maxSubpages.description: How many About / Team / Contact pages to open per site to find the owner and emails. 0 = homepage only (faster).

checkMx.title: Check email domain MX
checkMx.description: Light DNS check that the primary email's domain accepts mail. Not a full mailbox verification.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Upper bound for websites audited in parallel. The Actor lowers it automatically to about 1 site per 40 MB of run memory, because parsing pages is CPU bound. The default 1024 MB handles 100+ sites in a few minutes.

proxyFallback.title: Datacenter proxy fallback for blocked sites
proxyFallback.description: If a site blocks plain requests, retry once through Apify datacenter proxy. Never uses residential proxy unless you set it below.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty for direct requests (recommended). If set, all requests use this proxy.
